mostWorthwhile.text: Insulating the heat-traced line was most worthwhile: the explanation made the roles of insulation and heating physically clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the reflective insulation was a predictable intermediate step with no explanatory detail of its own.

surprise.text: The hose connection already joined the well to the processor and included a raw-water strainer; I had expected a separate connection might be needed.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless, though the final two choices were the only offered actions rather than meaningful decisions.

continue.text: I would probably continue for the practical engineering details and the expedition story, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
